answer: Persistent Attention Ledger. Each identity must answer randomized micro-tasks drawn from a live queue, and its score decays unless refreshed within a fixed half-life; only identities above threshold can transact. An opal badge marks auditors who can spot-check answers. Embedding a probe inside a grove of routine queries catches copy-paste bots. Each failed probe consumes an ember credit, and credits regenerate only through verified human-paced work. An attacker running N sock puppets pays N times the continuous labor hours, since capital cannot buy the clock.
